description: Deterministic mapping of tools and methodologies for discovering, analyzing, deduplicating, modularizing, and reusing packages and code across the ~/github/* workspace.

bindings.name: capability-and-intent-discovery
bindings.description: Performs local, zero-LLM-cost, high-speed SQLite FTS5 search across all ~240+ repositories in ~/github/ to locate existing capabilities, intents, and dependencies before authoring new components.
bindings.evidenceRequired: Search result list of candidate repositories or confirmation of novelty

bindings.name: workspace-topology-and-drift
bindings.description: Analyzes cross-repository topologies, drift between primary checkouts, active agent processes, and planfile ticket backlogs across the workspace.
bindings.evidenceRequired: Monag workspace snapshot and drift status

bindings.name: clone-detection-and-cross-comparison
bindings.description: Performs AST and block-level clone detection. Compares two projects to calculate shared LOC and recommend refactoring strategies (merge, extract, or keep separate).
bindings.evidenceRequired: redup scan/compare report with identified duplication groups and recoverable lines

bindings.name: continuous-modularization
bindings.description: Defines rules for extracting shared logic into focused standalone packages (under packages/ or dedicated domain repos) to facilitate multi-project consumption.
bindings.evidenceRequired: Isolated package boundary with clean interface contract and unit tests

bindings.name: planfile-task-decomposition
bindings.description: Decomposes reuse, extraction, and deduplication opportunities into structured planfile tickets (Discover, Compare, Extract, Consume, Verify) in .planfile/sprints/current.yaml.
bindings.evidenceRequired: Valid planfile.sprint/v1 sprint file populated with reuse tickets

bindings.name: closed-loop-autonomous-execution
bindings.description: Autonomously claims and executes reuse/deduplication tickets from the planfile queue in isolated worktrees until green verification is achieved.
bindings.evidenceRequired: Planfile ticket marked done with verification test output (exit code 0)

bindings.name: governed-documentation-sync
bindings.description: Enforces concise, structured documentation (Compact v2: 120 lines max, single topic) and automated API sync via code2docs for all non-fork user projects.
bindings.evidenceRequired: Canonical docs/ structure with index and valid markdown references

bindings.name: structured-event-and-error-runbooks
bindings.description: Requires append-only structured JSONL event logging and explicit runbooks in errors/{CODE}.md for every runtime failure mode.
bindings.evidenceRequired: errors/ catalog and conforming log schema
